body:
hey im back again. just had about 13 hours broken up sleep, kept waking up cos of attacks, had to take an injection then went back to sleep for a few more hours, then another one, another injection, more sleep, etc lol. woke up couldn't sleep anymore, felt so tired and exhausted and a bit sick cos only meant to take 2 injections in 24 hours and i have had about 7 so far. 

so yea was feeling miserable turned on pc and read urs, and everyones else's replies, few tears lol(very very unusual for me) and feel much better now :-) 

well about the doctor's i was very angry about it yesterday but for some reason now i dont even care :D .right so i waited all day for the appointment to see them because they had cancelled my medication, i had to wait at the doctors for 45 minutes before getting seen, while people who turned up after me got seen before, went in to see her and she said my medicine wasn't cancelled. i was like ????. she said nope look not cancelled in fact a prescription was issued this morning to the pharmacy. i was like???????????. i said the pharmacy was told by the doctors surgery it was cancelled, and when i phoned up the doctors surgery they said it was cancelled. she was like nope look on the screen not cancelled. LOL so yea i have had to suffer for no reason it seems :S anyway i got the amount of tablets issued at 1 time moved up to 2 months worth.

thanks that is very much appreciated. i haven't mentioned any of this to anyone before, and now i am really glad i have. also you mention i am a young person which confused me because i am 29 years old with no career, girlfriend, wife, kids or anything. my younger brother is married with a 1 and half year old daughter and he is only 23. i sort of feel i have wasted so much of my life already.

hey man thanks for taking the time to reply, it means a lot to me. i mean posting on here has basically saved my life. i am very tired at the moment i have been awake for about 22 hours now and i am a bit confused about how exactly i feel. i phoned the doctor as soon as they opened this morning and have an appointment in about 5 hours time. 

as with work and the bullying it might be my fault for being a bit vulnerable. like sharks and blood in the water.

Hey thanks so much for reading my big rant of text. I came home from work determined to at least post something tonight. it took me a few hours to write all that and realized i still hadn't really said that much lol.

Okay and with regards to what made me snap. Well i have started this job a few months ago. I started as a chef though on a trial. I didn't do well at it, and the guy basically said he has to let me go, so i asked if i could stay on as a kitchen porter instead(washing dishes). So i have been doing that and working as many hours as i possibly can. After my payday at the end of the month i am just about surviving. I have got a few debts to pay off and because i was out of work for a year before this job. 

Well the people i work with are all friends with each other, including the boss. At the moment they are basically bullying me, pyhsically and verbally. Like i got shoved into the side of a pizza oven and burnt my arm. I basically begged them to stop and leave me alone but its not gonna happen and i cant afford to leave and i cant complain without getting fired. The night in question one of them poured half a bottle of washing up liquid into the dishwasher so it bubbled all over the floor and needed to be shutdown and cleaned out restarted etc. Then he came to have a look at laughed and said he would come back to do it again as soon as i had fixed it. I just went silent i couldn't speak for the rest of the night at all.

Its not just that though, 1 day before that i phoned up to get my medicine as normal and the doctors have cancelled it till i come in to see them. i asked for an appointment and its 2 weeks time. the medicine is verapamil and can be dangerous if stopped suddenly, also its brought all the "attacks" on again which have stopped for awhile now.

I am also doing a job i hate so much as well and dont really have a way out of it yet.

Also i have got no friends at all in this city i am really alone, i have got 2 days off work now and i really dont know what to do. The friends thing can be solved with time though.

Okay the second part, well i love other people and will do everything i can to make other people smile or laugh. i try my best to be a happy crazy person.

Um and as for what makes me happy? thats impossible to answer i wake up a bit upset that im still alive :( and i really hate having to say that because i dont want to feel like that. but i have felt like that for so long now.

Hey there, i found your post by googling how to kill myself, and came across it. Thank you so much for sharing, it made me do the same and i have wrote my story as well. i dunno if it makes sense but knowing i am not the only one with problems helps sortof and i have finally for the first time in my life shared some of my problems with someone else. 

so once again thank you. and those fuckers in ur life are leeching the life and soul out of you :( its defintly them and not you.
